title: core BuildError::CborEncode loses original serde_ipld_dagcbor error
description: core/ipld/builder.rs converts serde_ipld_dagcbor::Error to BuildError::CborEncode(e.to_string()), discarding the original. If CBOR encoding fails due to oversized content or invalid CID, the caller sees only a generic string. Preserve the error chain or add a typed variant.
